metadata.datasource: Fotufilm runtime film profile by MUAStudio Inc.; released under CC BY-SA 4.0. Sampled characteristic curves preserve digitized Ilford HP5 Plus TI (Nov 2018) density records with C1 interpolation. The first and last 12 points of each record provide monotonic extrapolation outside the published range. Runtime rendering data only. See licenses/FILM-PROFILES.txt. Edge inscriptions and approximate physical placement follow the manufacturer references in edgePrinting.sources; see docs/print-frame-model.md. Sheet-notch metadata follows Ilford Notch Codes Guide; see sheetNotches.source. The DX edge barcode encodes the DX number cited in edgePrinting.dx.source. Development: ILFORD HP5 PLUS Technical Information (Nov 2018) p3; ILFORD ILFOTEC HC 1+31, 20 C, intermittent agitation. Reference time 6.5 min from the manufacturer datasheet; its curve was checked against that datasheet's graph (ILFORD HP5 Plus fact sheet, April 2010, p5, ILFOTEC HC 1+31 6.5 min: max 0.016 D). Development times 9.5, 14 min are Fotufilm estimates (its process-level rule applied to this film's curve), not manufacturer curves.
